verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Stir in me a love that's deep
A love that's wide
A love that's sweet
And help me Lord
To never keep it to myself

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
And if my heart should dimly burn
And if my feet should fail to run
Call my name
And I will come right back to You

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
I wanna stay close to You
It's really that simple
I wanna stay close to You
Just as simple as this song

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
I wanna stay close to You
It's really that simple
I wanna stay close to You
My whole life long
